title: Why bilona ghee costs more
caption:
Why does bilona ghee cost 3x more than regular ghee? 🧈

It starts with curd, not cream. The curd is hand-churned into makkhan and slow-heated into ghee. It takes about 25–30 litres of milk to make just 1 kg.

Our A2 Bilona Cow Ghee is made from desi cow milk the traditional way.

title: Cold-pressed vs refined
caption:
Cold-pressed vs refined oil. What's the difference? 🫒

Refined oil is usually extracted at high heat, often with chemical solvents, then bleached and deodorised.

Cold-pressed oil comes from seeds pressed slowly at low heat, with no solvents, so it keeps its natural aroma and taste.

Groundnut and sesame for South Indian cooking. Mustard for North Indian tadka.

title: Moringa daily tip
caption:
1 spoon of this green powder a day? 🌿

Moringa is made from dried drumstick tree leaves (munagaku / sahjan). It brings plant iron and calcium, vitamins A, C and E, antioxidants and plant protein.

Stir 1 tsp into buttermilk or warm water, mix into dal or chapati dough, or blend into smoothies.
